text:
endpoints/ contains 12 small Node modules. In each file, change the API_VERSION
constant from "v1" to "v2". Nothing else in the files should change. When you are
done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes.

content:
exit_code: 0
stdout:
accounts.js
assets.js
billing.js
catalog.js
devices.js

search.js
sessions.js
users.js

stderr:

arguments.command: cd endpoints && sed -i 's/const API_VERSION = "v1";/const API_VERSION = "v2";/' *.js && cd .. && grep -n 'API_VERSION = "v2"' endpoints/*.js | wc -l
